AboutHeroSubtitle: Delivering reliable window and door solutions for modern homes and buildings.
AboutHeroDesc: PNS Window specializes in professional window and door installation, replacement, and maintenance. We focus on quality craftsmanship, durable materials, and reliable service for every customer.
AboutHeroText:
Representative Korean window and door companies such as LG Hausys, KCC, and Hanssem have built strong credibility in large projects based on powerful brand recognition and standardized systems.

However, these systems are largely limited to standardized designs and specifications, making it difficult to fully reflect the diverse needs of individual customers.

PNS WINDOW, on the other hand, breaks away from the conventional approach and provides customer-centered customized window and door solutions.

We implement designs tailored to each customer's space and lifestyle, and through 3D simulation, customers can preview the color, size, and structure of windows in advance.

In addition, through fast and flexible communication and competitive pricing, we make premium design more accessible.

In particular, we support multilingual services (Korean, English, Uzbek) for smooth communication with various domestic and international customers.

PNS WINDOW is not just a window company. It is a next-generation window and door solution brand that combines design, technology, and customer experience.
AboutExperienceText1: South Korea is home to some of the most advanced window and door manufacturers in Asia. Large companies operate massive factories and produce thousands of window systems for construction projects.
AboutExperienceText2: At PNS Window, we combine modern manufacturing standards with personalized service. Our goal is not only to provide products but also to ensure proper installation, long-term reliability, and customer satisfaction.
AboutDifferentText1: Unlike large industrial manufacturers that focus on mass production, PNS Window focuses on delivering reliable solutions directly to customers. Our team works closely with each project to ensure accurate measurements, proper installation, and long-term durability.
AboutDifferentText2: We believe that the quality of installation is just as important as the quality of the product itself.
AboutProcessDesc: Our process is designed to guarantee precision and reliability. From the first consultation to the final installation, every step is carefully managed by experienced specialists.
AboutAdvantagesDesc: PNS Window delivers solutions that combine durability, design, and efficiency. Our window and door systems are built to improve comfort, insulation, and long-term performance.
AboutTrustDesc: Our mission is simple: deliver dependable window and door solutions with professional installation and long-term support. Every project we complete reflects our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

AboutIntroHeadline: Built in Korea, Designed for Modern Living.
AboutIntroHeadlineSub: From nationwide production bases to design-led PVC and aluminum systems, PNS unites Korean manufacturing discipline with in-house innovation—so every window and door delivers the insulation, security, and refined finish your project deserves.
AboutIntroPara1: At PNS, we believe windows and doors are more than building materials — they shape comfort, safety, energy efficiency, and the beauty of every space.
AboutIntroPara2: From modern residential projects to large-scale custom solutions, we combine Korean quality, innovative design, and trusted craftsmanship to deliver products that truly elevate everyday living.
AboutIntroPara3: Every detail matters to us — from precision manufacturing to professional installation and reliable after-service — so our customers can enjoy long-lasting value with complete confidence.
AboutIntroCard1Body: Rigorous testing, premium materials, and Korean manufacturing discipline ensure every profile, pane, and finish meets the performance you expect — and the look you will love for years.
AboutIntroCard2Body: From expert consultation and precise measurement to installation and after-service, we guide you at every step — so your investment feels clear, calm, and completely worth it.
AboutStatsHeroTitle: Windows & doors, engineered for life in Korea
AboutStatsHeroSub: Nationwide presence, decades of craft, and projects delivered with care—meet the scale behind every frame we build.
AboutAgentsSectionDesc: From precise on-site measurement to careful installation, our teams follow PNS standards in every region we serve—so your windows and doors look right, seal right, and last.
AboutHelpTitle: Planning a project or need advice?
AboutHelpSubtitle: Ask us about window and door styles, energy performance, sizing, or installation — our team is here to help you choose with confidence.
AboutBusanOptionsTitle: Why buyers choose our Busan branch
AboutBusanOption1Body: Advanced manufacturing and strict quality control bring profiles, glazing, and hardware together for lasting performance—stunning looks with the energy savings you expect year after year.
AboutBusanOption2Title: Smarter reach from Korea’s southern hub
AboutBusanOption2Body: Our Busan base supports coastal and nationwide projects with responsive timelines and specialists who know high-rises, villas, and bespoke facades—so delivery and support match your site reality.
AboutBusanOption3Body: We guide you through styles, dimensions, and installation with clear advice—so you invest in the right products once and enjoy results that feel as solid as they look.
PnsHistoryPageSubtitle: Eco-friendly milestones in PNS windows — from materials to certification and beyond.
PnsHistoryNews1Title: PNS Deojon Sash rises as a new leader in windows with eco-friendly sash
PnsHistoryNews1Body: A TV ad featuring Kim Tae-hee highlights PNS Deojon Sash. The company leads the Busan–Gyeongnam market with eco-friendly PVC windows, in-house R&D since 2010, and a dedicated plant in Cheonan.
PnsHistoryNews2Title: LG and KCC pushed by PNS toward “non-toxic” transition
PnsHistoryNews2Body: The domestic PVC stabilizer market is shifting from lead to non-toxic products. Major sash makers have accelerated non-toxic stabilizers since 2014 as environmental requirements tighten.
